Name: Bath
Description: Pet bath for shorter stays on request

Name: Daily Grooming
Description: Brushing of hair,Cleaning of eyes and ears,brushing of teeth (if dog amenable to it)(pet parent to provide toothbrush and cream),checking of paws,daily checks for ticks and fleas

Name: EXIT BATH
Description: Bath given after stay for 10 days or more in normal stays and after 15 days or more in monsoons(June to September)

Name: Medication
Description: Daily medication ,if required ,as per vet or pet parent instructions

Name: Special care
Description: Any special care required like for paraplegic dogs /blind dogs/wound dressings/care for pregnant dogs or any other special care will  be chargeable on case to case basis.

Name: Vet Visit
Description: If any vet visit required during the stay,charges of vet on actuals charged plus for transport
